method: read-only official documentation through web browsing; no package manager or model-provider execution
policy_status: PROPOSED; association decisions are ReproLLM design inferences, not upstream mandates

sources.limit_or_design_inference: Does not authorize adding unsupported directives or sibling membership.
sources.supported_fact_paraphrase: Requirements files have explicit requirement and constraint references; pip's complete grammar is broader than ReproLLM's bounded parser.
sources.title: Requirements File Format

sources.limit_or_design_inference: ReproLLM -c support remains outside this proposal; do not treat -c as -r.
sources.supported_fact_paraphrase: A constraint limits versions without itself requesting installation.
sources.title: Constraints Files

sources.limit_or_design_inference: Option A deliberately does not delegate a parent lock to members; this is a conservative policy limit, not native uv semantics.
sources.supported_fact_paraphrase: Workspace members have individual pyproject files and share a lock; membership can use include/exclude globs.
sources.title: Using workspaces

sources.limit_or_design_inference: Same-directory association is proposed static evidence, not proof the observed child installed through Poetry.
sources.supported_fact_paraphrase: Poetry uses the project's lock with its pyproject during Poetry installation; pip installation does not use that lock to choose dependency versions.
sources.title: Installing with poetry.lock

sources.limit_or_design_inference: A tool-only table is not automatically runtime dependency evidence under ReproLLM's existing contract.
sources.supported_fact_paraphrase: Build requirements, project metadata and arbitrary tool configuration are distinct tables.
sources.title: pyproject.toml specification

sources.limit_or_design_inference: Option A preserves only currently supported categories and does not validate lock content hashes or resolver results.
sources.supported_fact_paraphrase: Pipfile packages and dev-packages correspond to default and develop lock categories; Pipenv also documents custom categories.
sources.title: Pipfile and Pipfile.lock

sources.limit_or_design_inference: Option A's unique same-directory environment pairing is narrower than conda-lock capabilities and is not a claim of source-hash freshness.
sources.supported_fact_paraphrase: An environment source can generate a conda-lock.yml; the documentation also links other source formats.
sources.title: Basic Usage
